title: Virtual Tour of Intentional Communities: Oak Park Commons Cohousing
description: A one-hour online tour, hosted by author and community-living guide Cynthia Tina for the Foundation for Intentional Community, of Oak Park Commons, a newly built 24-unit, consensus-governed intergenerational cohousing community in Oak Park, Illinois, with a shared kitchen, great room, and other common spaces. Part of FIC's ongoing Virtual Tour series for people new to community; past tours are on FIC's YouTube channel. Pay-what-you-can, starting at $0. 1-2pm CT.
